# C05-01 — Distribution variants and channel packages

Status: verified

- Requirements: ST-012, ST-015
- Evaluations: EV-013, EV-014
- Inputs: approved ready piece, export manifest, configured channels, public copy and variants
- Output: versioned distribution plan separating internal IDs from public titles, descriptions, covers, formats and asset paths
- Dependencies: C04-06, C01-01
- Acceptance: only configured channels/variants are packaged; no publication is inferred; every asset is traceable to an export
- Verification: validate multiple channels, names and formats plus unknown references and duplicate variants
- Limit: a package does not prove a remote channel accepts or displays it correctly
